definitions.explanation: To go across something from side to side.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{庭|にわ}を{横切|よこぎ}った。
{子供|こども}が{道|みち}を{横切|よこぎ}った。
{車|くるま}が{目|め}の{前|まえ}を{横切|よこぎ}った。
examples.english: A car cut across right in front of me.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}を{横切|よこぎ}って{駅|えき}に{向|む}かった。
examples.english: I cut across the park and headed for the station.

notes:
{横切|よこぎ}る means to cross or traverse something horizontally, going from one side to the other.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: Xを{横切|よこぎ}る

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {道|みち}を{横切|よこぎ}る: to cross the road
- {庭|にわ}を{横切|よこぎ}る: to cross the yard
- {広場|ひろば}を{横切|よこぎ}る: to cross the square

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {横切|よこぎ}る: to cross (horizontally, from side to side)
- {渡|わた}る: to cross (bridge, river, road)
- {越|こ}える: to cross over, go beyond (mountains, borders)
- {通|とお}る: to pass through

ETYMOLOGY:
{横|よこ} (side/horizontal) + {切|き}る (to cut) - to 'cut across' something.
